propositions: Data Center backend has no value-level characterization test coverage; existing contract tests only assert shape presence, not correctness of values
The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is never exercised through WikiTextCodec, creating a blind spot for DC-specific regressions
Data Center sanitizer boundaries (summary, description, comment) are not pinned at exact limits or overflow points
Data Center's identity label form, probe branch classification, and resolved_statuses binding are not verified by value
The create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields must be pinned for every key and fallback branch it emits: summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee

The test suite requires parametrization over both backends to pin vendor-specific expected values, with mutation-checking recorded as evidence in both ticket comments and module-level test file blocks
